commandOnlyComparedTicketAndEpoch.before: a command carrying a foreign assignment, attempt or contract still passed because only ticket and epoch were compared
commandOnlyComparedTicketAndEpoch.after: the command must now match ticket, epoch, attempt id and the full contract (workId, revision, digest) against the claimed attempt, verified BEFORE the backend is touched; an optional assignment id must also match when present

largeFrameAndLargePageBudgetHitTheRespon.before: a requested 131072 page and one valid >64KiB writer.observed frame tripped the 64KiB response cap
largeFrameAndLargePageBudgetHitTheRespon.after: the cap is NOT raised. The inline page ceiling is 48KiB; a larger requested budget is honoured only up to that ceiling and both requestedMaxBytes and the effective budget are reported so a page is never silently truncated. A payload too large to inline is transferred BY REFERENCE through a dedicated GET /v1/payload?ref=&offset=&length= route returning bounded chunks with total and SHA-256 digest, and the client reassembles and can verify it
largeFrameAndLargePageBudgetHitTheRespon.honesty: the transport now has a real payload reader on both ends; the service serves chunks from the journal entry for that payloadRef
